scenes.desc: Opening. Slow camera tilt down from a dense starry sky with a Milky Way band to a sleeping rural Japanese village (layered blue mountain silhouettes, terraced rice fields reflecting stars, a few thatched/tiled roofs with warm windows, fireflies). Small calligraphic title 「ほしまいご」 fades in 1.0–2.8 and out by 3.2. Narration n1 at 3.0.

Hilltop. Hina (girl, yukata, paper lantern) stands on a grassy hill next to a big old tree & small stone lantern, seen from behind/side, looking at the sky. At 7.8 a shooting star streaks across. She turns (surprised), line h1 at 8.2. The star bends and comes straight toward the valley below, getting bigger; at 12.6 it hits the rice field below: big flash that whites out the frame by 13.5.

Rice field, small smoking glowing crater. Tiny star creature Kira sits crying (glowing tears). Hina runs in (13.8–15.0) and kneels. k1 at 14.3 (Kira crying, dim glow flickers). h2 at 20.0 Hina gently comforts, reaches out a hand; Kira hops onto her palm by ~23.5.

Close two-shot, Kira on Hina's palm between them. k2 at 24.2: Kira perks up hopefully, a little flicker of light. h3 at 28.6: Hina determined, fist pump, then (29.9–31.0) she opens her paper lantern and Kira hops inside, lantern glows.

Town montage, side-scrolling camera. Hina runs left→right through a narrow old-town street (wooden houses, noren, paper windows, telephone poles, hanging lanterns) holding the lantern with Kira. As she passes, windows slide open and the warm light of each house turns into floating 'thank-you' orbs that stream into her lantern; the house window goes soft/dim. Grandpa at a window at 32.2 (g1), a kid waving from a balcony at 36.5 (c1). Lantern becomes brighter and brighter; by 41 it's blazing and the street is filled with drifting orbs.

Back on the hilltop. Hina lifts the lantern; Kira emerges big (grown), radiant, floating in front of her. Wind lifts her hair and sleeves, grass waves. k3 at 42.0 (gentle). h4 at 46.0 (Hina whispers, teary but smiling). k4 at 48.2 (promise). Kira touches her forehead with a tiny point of light around 51.5; they both smile.

Ascension & finale. Kira rockets up into the sky leaving a glittering trail (53.0–54.6), Hina waves big and shouts h5 at 53.8. At 54.6 Kira bursts into a meteor shower over the whole village; the stars settle into a constellation shaped like Hina and Kira holding hands (55.5–57.5). Title 「ほしまいご」 appears large 56.8, fade to black 59.0–60.0.
